headline: Orchid Pharma Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Orchid Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update related to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Dhanuka Laboratories Limited ("Amalgamating Company") with Orchid Pharma Limited ("Amalgamated Company/Company") and their…
detail: Updates - Orchid Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update related to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Dhanuka Laboratories Limited ("Amalgamating Company") with Orchid Pharma Limited ("Amalgamated Company/Company") and their respective shareholdersand creditors ("the Scheme") under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI Listing Regulations"), as amended.'.
